proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ H K
  open Pointwise in
  have h0 : {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k} = (H : Set G) * (K : Set G) := by
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_mul, SetLike.mem_coe]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩; exact ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩; exact ⟨h, hh, k, hk, rfl⟩
  have h1 := Subgroup.card_mul_eq_card_subgroup_mul_card_quotient K (H : Set G)
  have h2 := MulAction.index_stabilizer H ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K)
  have hs : ∀ h : H, h • ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K) = (((h : G)) : G ⧸ K) := fun h => by
    change ((((h : G) * 1 : G)) : G ⧸ K) = _
    rw [mul_one]
  have h3 : MulAction.stabilizer H ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K) = K.subgroupOf H := by
    ext h
    rw [MulAction.mem_stabilizer_iff, Subgroup.mem_subgroupOf, hs, QuotientGroup.eq]
    simp [inv_mem_iff]
  have h4 : MulAction.orbit H ((1 : G) : G ⧸ K) = ((↑) : G → G ⧸ K) '' (H : Set G) := by
    ext q
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨h, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨h, h.2, (hs h).symm⟩
    · rintro ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨⟨h, hh⟩, hs ⟨h, hh⟩⟩
  have h5 : Nat.card (K.subgroupOf H) = Nat.card (H ⊓ K : Subgroup G) := by
    have := Nat.card_congr (Subgroup.equivMapOfInjective (K.subgroupOf H) H.subtype H.subtype_injective).toEquiv
    rw [this, Subgroup.subgroupOf_map_subtype, inf_comm]
  have h6 := (K.subgroupOf H).card_mul_index
  rw [h3, h4, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq] at h2
  rw [h0, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, h1, ← h2, ← h5, ← h6]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (H K : Subgroup G), Set.ncard {x : G | ∃ h ∈ H, ∃ k ∈ K, x = h * k} * Nat.card (H ⊓ K : Subgroup G) = Nat.card H * Nat.card K
